betterquesting:10.desc:8:
The Vibration Chamber burns solid fuels to generate AE power. It is AE2's own power generator, useful before you have a large external power setup.

It produces 5 AE per tick, with burn speed that scales dynamically from 20 to 200 based on network demand. When the network needs more power, the chamber burns fuel faster. When there is a surplus, it slows down to conserve.

Any fuel that works in a vanilla furnace works here: coal, charcoal, lava buckets, etc.

The chamber outputs power directly to the cable network, no Energy Acceptor needed.

§ePS:§f A tree farm feeding charcoal into a Vibration Chamber is a solid early-game AE power source. But you will want external RF/FE generation once your network grows.
